newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle firm on carcass basis - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle firm on carcass basis - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not established on a live basis, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said. Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1325 lb few 65.00-65.50.
Carcass basis compared with Tuesday's close - Steers and heifers firm to $1.00 per cwt higher.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lb 104.00-105.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lb 104.00-104.50.
Reported sales Tuesday - 1,400 Week to Date - 20,000
